subject: MAP Eval Playbook — Week 1 alignment
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Eval Playbook — Week 1 alignment

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our agreement, attaching the initial MAP and a short eval runbook so we have a single source of truth for owners and milestones this week. High-level asks for the next 7 days: 

- Confirm test data access (S3 bucket + read-only creds) — owner: Acme (Sara) — due: 2026-08-04
- Provide list of 3 representative production prompts (PII-redacted) — owner: Acme Eval Team — due: 2026-08-05
- Redwood to stand up the dedicated eval endpoint and share perf baseline (p50/p95) — owner: Karthik — due: 2026-08-06
- Define success criteria for model quality (accept/reject thresholds) — owner: Marissa & Sara — due: 2026-08-07

Decisions from yesterday: Redwood will run a 3-run evaluation against the provided prompt set; Acme will provide a non-prod S3 bucket and an endpoint for telemetry sampling. If any blocker pops up we escalate to Rishi for SLA exceptions.

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners), eval_runbook_v0.2.md (steps & metrics), performance_targets.csv (draft SLOs).

Planned touchpoints: quick standup Thu 08/05 10:00 AM PT to confirm access, full review Fri 08/06 11:00 AM PT for initial baseline. Please reply with any owner changes.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwood.com]

From: Sara Lee <sara@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Eval Team <eval-team@acme.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Eval Playbook — Week 1 alignment

Hi Hannah —

Got it, and thanks for consolidating. A couple quick clarifications: 

- We can provision an S3 bucket by EOD Wednesday (08/04). I will be the owner for the access ticket.
- For prompts, I'll pull three anonymized examples from production and share by Thursday morning.
- Can you confirm whether the eval endpoint will mirror the production model (same model ID) or a lighter quantized variant? We care about representative latency.

Also — can Karthik share the expected ingestion format (CSV vs JSONL)? Our infra team prefers JSONL.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lee
Director, Product Ops, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Acme MAP — prep notes before Thu standup

Quick internal note after product & infra sync this morning (do not forward to Acme yet):

1) Access flow: security will create a temporary role for Redwood with least privilege to the provided S3 path. Need Acme ARN + bucket name (Sara to provide).
2) Format preference: we'll accept JSONL; Karthik to confirm the exact schema and provide example ingestion snippet.
3) Eval runner: default will be the production model but we will instrument both production and a quantized 8-bit variant to track quality delta. Flagging potential risk: 8-bit may drift on corner cases — we should notify Acme when we send results.

Action items (internal owners):
- Karthik: ingestion schema + sample code — due 2026-08-05
- Rishi: prepare an escalation path and credit plan if perf is off by >30% — due 2026-08-06
- Marissa: draft recommended success criteria to share with Acme — due 2026-08-07

I will join the Thu standup and help unblock the bucket provisioning.

-Marissa
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sara Lee <sara@acme.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Eval Playbook — Week 1 alignment

Hi all —

Posting quick technical notes from the infra work: 

- Ingestion: JSONL with these fields: id, prompt, metadata (json). Example snippet attached in Drive (see link in MAP). We'll accept CSV but JSONL is preferred.
- Endpoint: we'll spin up a dedicated eval endpoint that mirrors the production model weights (model-id: rw-prod-v3), and a quantized variant (rw-prod-v3-q8) for cost-sensitivity checks. Both endpoints will be available in the same region (us-west-2).
- Perf baseline: initial smoke run shows p50 ~ 62ms, p95 ~ 180ms on a 4xA100 pool for the sample batch. Will run full baseline tomorrow when we have the prompt set.

Open question for Acme: do you want us to include golden-label scoring (human labels) as part of the initial pass, or run an automated metric-only evaluation and gate human labeling to the review stage?

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Update & Week 1 recap — decisions and owners

Hi everyone —

Summary of decisions and owners after this week's checkpoints: 

Decisions:
- Redwood will run the automated metric-first evaluation on Friday 2026-08-06 using the production model mirror; human labeling will be scoped as a follow-up if automated results show >5% metric variance vs your baseline.
- We will provide both raw metrics and a small sample of generated outputs (redacted) for qualitative review.
- If p95 latency exceeds 250ms on the eval endpoint, Redwood will open a mitigation ticket and propose reserved capacity options.

Finalized action items (owners & due dates):
- Acme (Sara): Provide S3 bucket name + IAM ARN for temporary role — due: 2026-08-04 (received)
- Acme Eval Team: Share 3 anonymized prompts in JSONL — due: 2026-08-05 (received)
- Karthik: Full baseline run (p50/p95 + resource footprint) and perf report — due: 2026-08-06 (completed)
- Marissa & Acme: Agree on pass/fail thresholds for core metrics (precision@k, semantic similarity) — draft due: 2026-08-09
- Rishi: Escalation & credit proposal if perf delta >30% — due: 2026-08-10

Attachments updated: MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx (owners & timeline updated), performance_targets.csv (finalized SLOs).

Next-week agenda (proposed):
- Mon 08/09: Go/no-go decision check (internal) + prep for customer review
- Wed 08/11: Customer review of automated results + decision about human labeling
- Fri 08/13: Finalize commercial proposal (if go) / next steps for optimization (if no-go)

Please confirm the agenda or suggest changes. If anything here looks off, flag inline and I'll update the MAP.

Thanks,
Hannah
From: Sara Lee <sara@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Eval Team <eval-team@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Eval Playbook — Week 1 alignment

Thanks Hannah — this recap looks good and aligns with our internal expectations. Appreciate the quick baseline.

We confirm the agenda for next week. We'll have a few product managers on the Wed 08/11 call for the qualitative review. Also: Marissa, I'll review your draft thresholds and add comments by EOD 08/09.

See you on Mon for the internal go/no-go.

Best,
Sara
